verdict.rationale: Workflow automation is a fair axis for a team chat tool, but the evidence shows no native no-code workflow builder triggered by events, schedules, or form submissions. What it does show are developer building blocks: a code-based bot framework, incoming webhooks and an API. Automation through Zapier and IFTTT runs in third-party tools, which counts as a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can build no-code workflows triggered by events, schedules, or form submissions inside the chat tool
